items.text: Fixed train collision lookup bug by caching HittableByTrains owner entity, improving barricade save performance.
Fixed crash when switching cameras, eliminating error spam.
Fixed bandage world model collision size and outline reference, improving interaction.
Reduced fireplace deployment volume, allowing placement under existing floors.
Repaired corrupted hazmat suit prefab, restoring the item.
Fixed chainsaw world model highlight and reduced highlight draw count.
Added refreshed flashlight animation for third‑person view and new admire animation.
Blockers now play damage‑state visual effects when damaged.
Fixed long market terminal names overflow rendering.
Corrected smart alarm text typo and radial wheel label.
Improved toast notifications display.
Fixed preview player model bugs and improved live icon rendering in character customization UI.
Introduced frog critter with initial setup.
Reduced craft costs for mortar, hazmat suit, and HMLMG; made prisoner hood a default blueprint and removed it from the tech tree.

2026-08-21.summary:
### Gameplay & Stability
- Fixed train collision lookup bug by caching HittableByTrains owner entity, improving barricade save performance.
- Fixed crash when switching cameras, eliminating error spam.

### Items, Weapons & Structures
- Fixed bandage world model collision size and outline reference, improving interaction.
- Reduced fireplace deployment volume, allowing placement under existing floors.
- Repaired corrupted hazmat suit prefab, restoring the item.
- Fixed chainsaw world model highlight and reduced highlight draw count.
- Added refreshed flashlight animation for third‑person view and new admire animation.
- Blockers now play damage‑state visual effects when damaged.

### UI & Customization
- Fixed long market terminal names overflow rendering.
- Corrected smart alarm text typo and radial wheel label.
- Improved toast notifications display.
- Fixed preview player model bugs and improved live icon rendering in character customization UI.

### Animals & NPCs
- Introduced frog critter with initial setup.

### Balance Changes
- Reduced craft costs for mortar, hazmat suit, and HMLMG; made prisoner hood a default blueprint and removed it from the tech tree.

items.text: Fixed old scientists movement and AI getting stuck, including crouch‑walk angle on stairs and slower behavior.
Improved navmesh sampling to eliminate spikes from unreachable points.
Deployables placed inside rooms now work via separate network groups.
Added a repairable helipad at the bandit camp; players must contribute resources to unlock air vehicle purchases, and it stays repaired until the next wipe.
Tuned conversation readout timings for clearer dialogue pacing.

2026-08-20.summary:
### NPC & AI
- Fixed old scientists movement and AI getting stuck, including crouch‑walk angle on stairs and slower behavior.
- Improved navmesh sampling to eliminate spikes from unreachable points.

### Monuments & Structures
- Deployables placed inside rooms now work via separate network groups.
- Added a repairable helipad at the bandit camp; players must contribute resources to unlock air vehicle purchases, and it stays repaired until the next wipe.

### UI & Gameplay
- Tuned conversation readout timings for clearer dialogue pacing.
